plain: Hi team, just a reminder that expense reports are due Friday. Anything submitted late will be paid next month.
legal: All employees are reminded that expense reports shall be submitted no later than Friday. Any expense report submitted after that date shall be processed in the following month's payment cycle.

plain: We're happy to confirm your booking for 4 nights from July 10. Please pay the remaining $640 at check-in.
legal: The Hotel confirms the Guest's reservation for four (4) nights commencing July 10. The outstanding balance of $640 shall be paid upon check-in.

plain: You can work from anywhere, but you need to be online during core hours. If you can't be, tell your manager in advance.
legal: The Employee may work from any location, provided that the Employee is available online during core hours. Where the Employee is unable to be available during core hours, the Employee shall notify the Employee's manager in advance.

plain: The project will be done in three phases. We'll send an invoice at the end of each phase. Each invoice must be paid within 21 days.
legal: The Project shall be performed in three (3) phases. The Provider shall issue an invoice upon completion of each phase, and each such invoice shall be payable within twenty-one (21) days.

plain: Thanks for your order. Your items will ship within 2 business days. If something's wrong, contact us within 30 days.
legal: The Company acknowledges receipt of the Customer's order. The items shall be dispatched within two (2) business days. Any issue with the order shall be reported to the Company within thirty (30) days of delivery.

plain: The landlord can keep the deposit if you damage the place. But they have to give you a list of the damage and the costs.
legal: The Landlord may retain the security deposit in respect of any damage caused to the Premises. The Landlord shall, however, provide the Tenant with an itemized statement of such damage and the associated costs.

plain: Don't share the beta with anyone. It's still being tested and might have bugs. Send any feedback to the product team.
legal: The Participant shall not share the beta version with any other person. The beta version remains under testing and may contain defects. All feedback shall be submitted to the product team.

plain: If you're sick on a workday, let us know before 9 am. After 3 days, you'll need a doctor's note.
legal: An Employee who is unable to work due to illness shall notify the Company before 9 am on the relevant working day. Any absence exceeding three (3) days shall be supported by a medical certificate.

plain: Our support team is available Monday to Friday. We aim to answer every email within one business day. Urgent issues should be reported by phone.
legal: The support team shall be available from Monday to Friday. The Company shall endeavor to respond to each email within one (1) business day. Urgent matters shall be reported by telephone.

plain: We've reviewed your request and can extend the deadline to June 30. No further extensions will be granted.
legal: Having reviewed the request, the Company hereby extends the deadline to June 30. No further extension shall be granted.

plain: The seller will fix the roof before the sale. If it isn't fixed by closing, the price drops by $8,000.
legal: The Seller shall repair the roof prior to completion. If the roof has not been repaired by the date of completion, the purchase price shall be reduced by $8,000.

plain: Each member brings a dish to the potluck. Drinks are provided by the club. Please let us know about allergies by Wednesday.
legal: Each Member shall contribute a dish to the potluck. Beverages shall be provided by the Club. Members shall notify the Club of any allergies no later than Wednesday.

plain: You can return the laptop within 14 days if it's in perfect condition. After that, we only offer repairs under warranty.
legal: The Customer may return the Laptop within fourteen (14) days, provided that it is in perfect condition. Thereafter, the Company shall provide only repairs under the warranty.

plain: Classes start on September 2. Fees must be paid in full before the first class. Students who haven't paid can't attend.
legal: Classes shall commence on September 2. Fees shall be paid in full prior to the first class. Students whose fees remain unpaid shall not be permitted to attend.

plain: The contractor will finish the kitchen by April 15. For each week of delay, they'll knock $300 off the price.
legal: The Contractor shall complete the kitchen on or before April 15. For each week of delay, the contract price shall be reduced by $300.

plain: We're changing our prices from next month. Current customers keep their old price for 6 more months.
legal: The Company shall revise its prices with effect from the following month. Existing customers shall retain their current prices for a further period of six (6) months.

plain: Parking is free for guests. Spaces are first come, first served. We're not responsible for damage to cars.
legal: Parking shall be provided free of charge to guests on a first-come, first-served basis. The Hotel shall not be liable for any damage to vehicles.

plain: Please don't post photos of the venue online. The client wants to keep the design private until launch.
legal: Attendees shall not publish photographs of the venue online. The Client wishes to keep the design confidential until its launch.

plain: The investor puts in $200,000 now and another $300,000 if we hit our sales target. The target is $1,000,000 in revenue by year-end.
legal: The Investor shall invest $200,000 upon signing and a further $300,000 upon the Company achieving its sales target. The sales target shall be revenue of $1,000,000 by the end of the financial year.

plain: Volunteers get free lunch on event days. They also get a T-shirt. They don't get paid.
legal: Volunteers shall receive a complimentary lunch on each event day, together with a T-shirt. Volunteers shall not receive any remuneration.

plain: If the goods are damaged when they arrive, take photos and email them to us within 48 hours. We'll send a replacement.
legal: If the Goods arrive in a damaged condition, the Buyer shall photograph the damage and email the photographs to the Seller within forty-eight (48) hours. The Seller shall thereupon dispatch replacement Goods.

plain: The agreement can be renewed for another year if both of us agree in writing. Otherwise it ends on December 31.
legal: This Agreement may be renewed for a further term of one (1) year by written agreement of both Parties. Failing such agreement, this Agreement shall terminate on December 31.

plain: We need your signed contract before we can start. Please send it back by Monday. If we don't get it, we'll release your booking.
legal: The Company shall not commence the Services until it has received the signed contract. The Client shall return the signed contract by Monday, failing which the Company may release the Client's booking.

plain: Trainees must pass all modules. Anyone who fails can retake a module once. A second failure ends the program.
legal: Trainees shall pass all modules. A Trainee who fails a module may retake it once. A second failure shall result in the Trainee's withdrawal from the program.

plain: The house rules are simple. No shoes inside, no loud music after 10 pm, and clean up after yourself.
legal: The following house rules shall apply. Shoes shall not be worn indoors, loud music shall not be played after 10 pm, and each occupant shall clean up after themselves.

plain: We'll process your refund once we receive the item. It can take up to 5 business days. You'll get an email when it's done.
legal: The refund shall be processed upon receipt of the returned item. Processing may take up to five (5) business days. The Customer shall receive an email confirmation upon completion.

plain: You own your designs. We just need permission to print them on the products you order.
legal: The Customer retains ownership of the Customer's designs. The Customer grants the Company a license to reproduce such designs solely on the products ordered by the Customer.

plain: The match starts at 3 pm. Players need to be there by 2:15 pm for warm-up. Anyone late may not play.
legal: The match shall commence at 3 pm. Players shall arrive no later than 2:15 pm for the warm-up. Any player who arrives late may be excluded from play.

plain: You can pay monthly or yearly. Yearly plans are 20% cheaper but can't be refunded.
legal: The Customer may elect to pay on a monthly or annual basis. Annual plans shall be offered at a discount of 20% and shall be non-refundable.

plain: The office will close at 2 pm on December 24. It reopens on January 2. Urgent issues can be sent to the on-call manager.
legal: The office shall close at 2 pm on December 24 and reopen on January 2. Urgent matters shall be referred to the on-call manager.

plain: Your account will be locked after 5 failed login attempts. To unlock it, reset your password.
legal: The User's account shall be locked following five (5) unsuccessful login attempts. The account may be unlocked by resetting the password.

plain: We may share anonymized research results publicly. We will never publish anything that identifies you.
legal: The Researchers may publish anonymized research results. The Researchers shall not publish any information that identifies a Participant.

plain: Applicants must be over 21 and have a clean driving record. Applications close on May 31.
legal: Applicants shall be over the age of twenty-one (21) and shall have a clean driving record. The application period shall close on May 31.

plain: The sublet runs from June 1 to August 31. Rent is $900 a month, paid to me, not the landlord.
legal: The sublease shall run from June 1 to August 31. The monthly rent of $900 shall be paid directly to the Sublessor and not to the Landlord.

plain: If the speaker cancels, we'll find a replacement. If we can't, you get your ticket money back.
legal: In the event that the Speaker cancels, the Organizer shall secure a replacement speaker. If the Organizer is unable to do so, ticket holders shall receive a refund of the ticket price.

plain: The first consultation is free. After that, each session is $120. Sessions last 50 minutes.
legal: The initial consultation shall be provided free of charge. Each subsequent session shall be charged at $120. Each session shall last fifty (50) minutes.

plain: Remember to lock the gate. If the dog gets out, the owner is responsible for any damage it causes.
legal: The gate shall be kept locked at all times. The Owner shall be liable for any damage caused by the dog should it escape.

plain: We can't guarantee delivery before the holidays for orders placed after December 15.
legal: The Company does not guarantee delivery before the holiday period in respect of orders placed after December 15.

plain: All staff must complete the security course by October 31. Access will be suspended for anyone who hasn't.
legal: All staff shall complete the security course by October 31. Access shall be suspended for any staff member who has not completed the course by that date.

plain: The tenant may make small changes like hanging pictures. Bigger changes need written approval.
legal: The Tenant may make minor alterations, such as hanging pictures. Any other alterations shall require the Landlord's prior written approval.
